page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g7.16xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 64 dedicated physical cores utilizing the x86_64 Intel Xeon 8369B processor running at 2.7 GHz. The instance is configured with 256.0 GB of RAM, providing a balanced 4.0 GB of memory per core. It does not include local storage or integrated GPUs, relying instead on network-attached storage. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 32 Gbps.

Benchmark data indicates strong multi-core capabilities, with the instance scoring in the top 25% for stress-ng multi-core performance and Geekbench multi-core metrics. Single-core performance remains average, as shown by Geekbench single-core and stress-ng single-core tests. The hardware supports advanced instruction sets including AVX-512F and AVX512_VNNI, which contribute to strong performance in specialized workloads like software compilation, ray tracing, and Passmark CPU encryption. Memory performance is also strong, though large-block uncached read and write bandwidths fall in the average range.

Given its balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio and high multi-threaded throughput, the ecs.g7.16xlarge is highly efficient for resource-dense enterprise workloads. It demonstrates strong performance in database operations and static web serving. It is also capable of handling small-scale LLM inference, processing 2432.91 tokens per second on a 135M model, though performance drops to average levels for 7B models. This makes the instance well-suited for multi-threaded applications, software build pipelines, database hosting, and web serving, offering a balanced performance-to-resource profile without the overhead of specialized GPU or local storage hardware.
